AC amendment (gap G6): cde1-30ba dependency. T4 imports cde1's Action enum and CANNOT proceed before cde1 closes. Story-level depends_on already declares cde1-30ba-d186-48d2 (verified). Sprint orchestrator's pre-dispatch grep already specified in T4 description:
`.claude/scripts/dso ticket show cde1-30ba-d186-48d2 | jq -e '.status == "closed"'`
This is the authoritative gate — if cde1 is OPEN at T4 dispatch time, BLOCK T4 (do NOT proceed). T4's deps T3-only at task level is intentional because story-level deps capture sibling-story coordination; restating cde1 in T4's task depends_on would be redundant. The pre-dispatch grep is the operative gate.
